decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's underground mining and industrial transport knowledge, enabling it to interpret feedback and improve the dump trucks rather than drop them.
The construction site dumper draws on existing construction and material handling expertise, so the firm can assimilate early results and refine the product.

The inclined furniture lift is only weakly related to the firm's core heavy lifting and industrial transport knowledge, limiting its ability to learn from results and improve, so withdrawal is more likely.
The inclined building material lift is closely aligned with the firm's construction and lifting capabilities, supporting effective learning and product improvement.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift leverages the firm's vehicle and lifting know-how, providing moderate absorptive capacity despite its niche furniture application.
